cc:Work.dc:description: Joint audit replay of 48 Guignot P–V–T observations and six PPv shock states, with the audit's specific-heat Cvm convention and starting-material transition energies. Static curves are labelled representative isotherms; shock curves retain each initial density and transition energy. Residuals use each observation's actual state. The displayed vertical pressure RMS is at observed coordinates, distinct from the stored orthogonal objective with latent P,V,T/density adjustments. Shock temperatures are independent diagnostics and were not fitted to the solid PPv inversion.
